Mail.Subject: Action required: secure your account with Microsoft Authenticator
Mail.Intro: to protect your company account against misuse, sign-ins require a second factor in addition to your password (multi-factor authentication, MFA). Your account is not yet set up with a secure method. Please set up the Microsoft Authenticator app – it only takes about 5 minutes.
Mail.Need: You need: your computer and your smartphone.
Mail.Step1.Title: Install Microsoft Authenticator on your smartphone
Mail.Step1.Text: Install the free "Microsoft Authenticator" app from the {0} (iPhone) or from {1} (Android).
Mail.Step2.Title: Open the security info page on your computer
Mail.Step2.Text: Open {0} in your browser and sign in with {1}. Then click "Add sign-in method".
Mail.Step3.Title: Select Microsoft Authenticator
Mail.Step4.Title: Click "Next" twice
Mail.Step4.Text: The page reminds you to install the app and to add an account in it. Click "Next" each time.
Mail.Step5.Title: Add your account in the app
Mail.Step5.Text: Open Microsoft Authenticator on your smartphone, tap "+", select "Work or school account" and then "Scan QR code". Allow notifications if asked.
Mail.Step6.Title: Scan the QR code and confirm
Mail.Step6.Text: Scan the QR code shown on your computer with your smartphone and click "Next". Microsoft then sends a test notification: enter the number shown on your computer in the app and confirm.
Mail.Done: Done! From now on you confirm sign-ins with the Microsoft Authenticator app.
Mail.Fallback.Title: Can't or don't want to use the app?
Mail.Fallback.Text: If you don't have a smartphone or don't want to use the app, please contact the IT department – simply reply to this email. We will find another solution with you, for example a security key.
Mail.Security: This email was sent by your IT department. The link leads to the official Microsoft page aka.ms/mfasetup. We will never ask you for your password.
Mail.Note: The screenshots may differ slightly depending on language and app version.
